## Key Takeaways for Report

- wwjc is a **top performer** in its peer group (Lighting / Full, N=8)
- Health Score at 76.0 is Q4 (100th percentile) — well above peer median of 64.5
- **Strengths**: Orders volume (Q4), catalog completeness (Q4), login intensity (Q4), operational health (Q4)
- **Gaps**: orders_per_user (Q2 — order volume is high but per-user efficiency lags), trajectory (Q2 — declining from prior period)
- **Adoption** is slightly below median (90 vs. 95) — Q3
